text:
The lake wind advisory is the headline for the waterfront this evening, with northwest winds at 15 to 20 knots, a few gusts near 25, and waves running 1 to 3 feet. If you're heading out for sunset, expect partly sunny skies and a brisk feel on the water, with the breeze easing tonight as clouds thin and temperatures fall toward 53.

Friday looks like the easy one: sunny, seasonably cool, and right around 73 with a lighter northwest wind. The lake should settle to waves of a foot or less, so tomorrow is a much better bet for a waterfront plan than tonight. I'd keep tonight's outing close to shore and wind-aware, then take advantage of the calmer, sunnier lake conditions Friday.

week.blurb: A breezy, partly sunny afternoon reaches 76, with a crisp, mostly clear night around 53.
Sunshine and a high near 73 make Friday an easy day for outdoor plans, with a clear, cool night.
Sunny and near 78, Saturday looks warm for plans, though the models disagree on how warm.
Warm and partly sunny near 81, Sunday turns unsettled after 2 with a 50% chance of showers or thunderstorms.
A few early showers may linger, then Monday turns mostly sunny and cooler near 68.
Mostly sunny and near 74, Tuesday brings a late shower risk and a stormier, breezy night.
Partly sunny and near 74, Wednesday carries a 40% chance of showers, continuing into a cloudier night.

Storms taper off Sunday night as a cooler, drier airmass arrives for Monday, bringing mostly sunny skies and crisp highs near 68° with overnight lows dropping into the upper 40s.
